name: ATK_POPUP_ITEMS
description: Table to store notifications for users delivered by UMS.

columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Generated Message Identifier.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier from SOA

columns.name: UMS_MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Message Identifier provided from source of this notification (SOA/CRM). Used for diagnosing any delivery issues.

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: User Identifier. This is the user that the message is addressed to.

columns.name: TASK_DISPLAY_URL
columns.description: This is the drilldown URL for viewing notification details.

columns.name: TASK_DETAILS_AVAILABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates whether notification details are available in source of this notification (SOA/CRM).

columns.name: TASK_STATE
columns.description: TASK_STATE

columns.name: SOA_SERVER
columns.description: SOA Server name of the Human Workflow Task created

columns.name: SOA_OUTCOMES
columns.description: Outcomes for the current Task used to complete custom actions inline

columns.name: SOA_OUTCOMES_DISPLAY
columns.description: Outcomes names to be displayed to the user as inline custom actions

columns.name: TASK_CREATOR
columns.description: FROM_USER

columns.name: MESSAGE_CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Message creation date in java long format. Indicates when the message was created in source of this notification (SOA/CRM).

columns.name: MESSAGE_EXPIRY_DATE
columns.description: Message expiry date in java long format. Indicates when the message will be expired.

columns.name: MESSAGE_SUMMARY
columns.description: Notification summary.

columns.name: THINGS_TO_FINISH_STATE
columns.description: Indicates whether the notification  has to shown in things to finish section or not Valid values are null or HIDE.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Indicates whether the notification has been viewed by the user. Valid values are READ and UNREAD.

columns.name: MSG_CREATION_DB_DATE
columns.description: Message creation date in database timestamp format. Indicates when the message was created in source of this notification (SOA/CRM).

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Indicates whether the notification is from SOA for human task delivered by UMS or if its from CRM for Calender Appointment/Task/Reminder. Valid values are  'SOA_HUMAN_TASK' and 'CRM_CALENDAR_APPOINTMENT'

columns.name: RENDERED_EXPRESSION
columns.description: Conditional Expression to check if the user has access to the particular Announcement notification or not.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of Notification. Whether it will open up in a Dialog or Drill Down or no details at all.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_ATTRIBUTES
columns.description: All the additional Attributes passed on from BPM.

columns.name: NAVIGATION_URL_KEY
columns.description:
This is the key to determine the host, port, context root, etc. to construct the url for the UI drilldown from watchlist item. Reference to FND_DEPLOYMENTS.DEPLOYMENT_NAME .
This will be used for the applcore ui shell navigate api that will be used for UI navigation across applications.

columns.name: VIEW_ID
columns.description: The view id (as per the ui shell menu) for the workarea/page that contains the task flow for this notification.

columns.name: PAGE_PARAM_LIST_STRING
columns.description: Parameters list for the page. If the target workarea page accepts page parameters, this is a semicolon delimited String of name value pairs.

columns.name: TASKFLOW_ID
columns.description: The task flow for this notification item's drilldown from Notification Bell Popup

columns.name: TF_KEY_LIST_STRING
columns.description: Key list to pass into the task flow to open in the target workspace. This is a semicolon delimited keys or key-value pairs. For example, "key1;key2=value2".

columns.name: TF_PARAMETER_STRING
columns.description:
Parameters list to pass in to the task flow to open in the target workspace. This is a semicolon delimited String of name value pairs. For example, "param1=value1;param2=value2"
For user created saved search, the view criteria id will be appended to this string (the string will need to end with <paramName>=  for saved search). Required if WATCHLIST_ITEM_TYPE IN (SEEDED_SAVED_SEARCH, USER_SAVED_SEARCH) .

columns.name: TASK_TAB_LABEL
columns.description: Label for the task flow to open in the target workspace. This should be an EL expression with fully qualified resource bundle reference within the target application.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
